No at-rest artifact, TTL, scope or crypto behaviour changes. One residual question for integration: the comment describes SSDWriteBehind.consume behaviour (the conditional charging order) that is in a file outside this batch (SSDWriteBehind.swift), and I did not verify that. That affects only wear-accounting documentation, not a confidentiality conclusion. No finding and no threat-model update needed from this unit.
